apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Mac (Buddy Lite)
• Every https call failed on a Mac without python.org's Python 3.12: the update check after each start (CERTIFICATEVERIFYFAILED ... unable to get local issuer certificate), and a brain on the internet goes through the same kind of call. The app looked for certificate authorities in a folder of the Python it was built with, and shipped none. It now uses the certificates macOS ships when Python has none (pull request 45).
• A Mac with 1.13.0 or older needs the install line once. A Buddy with this bug cannot fetch the update that fixes it:
• Windows
• Nothing changes in what Buddy does. The version number moves with the Mac's.
• The build no longer leaves the libraries out of Buddy.exe when it is made from the .venv that setup.bat creates (pull request 47). No released version was built that way; this one is the first built from a fresh copy of the repo with its own .venv.
• Checked
• Mac, before the release, on a MacBook Pro 2019 (Intel, macOS 15.7): the released 1.13.0 passed its self-test, 24 of 24, and showed the bug after every start. The app built from pull request 45 reported "httpscertificates": "macos file" there. On GitHub's Macs (Apple Silicon and Intel) the tests and the built app's self-test passed.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
